title: test(ui-live-e2e): pin the live lane's backend to the published 18.2.0
body:
Part of #25914

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 live e2e 车道的后端钉 `ui/e2e/live/ci/backend.env` 的 `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` 从 18.1.0 改为 18.2.0，只有这一行。
- 为什么改：按裁决 6464191239（D 第 1 步）。钉在 18.1.0 时，四个 live spec 连跑 5 次全红；改成 18.2.0 后，5 次全绿。
- 风险与回滚：没有接入任何 CI，也没有任何 required 检查读取这个文件，只影响手动跑的 live 车道。要回滚，revert 这一行即可。
- 先看：`ui/e2e/live/ci/backend.env` 第 16 行。
- 两分钟验证：`bash ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` 应输出 `resolved @objectstack/cli@18.2.0`，并以 `ready: seeded sign-in answered` 结束。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/e2e/live/ci/backend.env`: `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` 18.1.0 → 18.2.0, the version this tree's `packages/cli` is at and npm's `latest`. No other value in the file names the old version; its comments describe the pin, not its value. This is step 1 of ruling 6464191239, letter D. It wires nothing into CI. Step 2 (boot the workspace backend, add the `ci.yml` job, enrol it in `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`) is the separate card that ruling filed. Q3 B (the 18 unrun live specs, `domain:ui`) also stays open on #25914, which is why this PR is `Part of` and does not close the card.

## Tests

The four `test:e2e:live:ci` specs, 5 consecutive runs, `--retries 0` (the config already pins `retries: 0`, `workers: 1`), with the COMMITTED file at `837f1f05`, which is this branch before the `origin/main` merge. The merge brought no change under `ui/e2e/live/`.

Boot recipe, the deleted objectui `live-e2e.yml` one: `start-backend.sh` from a fresh `LIVE_BACKEND_DIR` (cold prepare and boot 104 s; `resolved @objectstack/cli@18.2.0 -> 27f38ada4981`), then `VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build` of `ui/apps/console`, then `vite preview` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET` at the backend, and `LIVE_API_URL` / `LIVE_APP_URL` set.

| run | exit | wall | action-modal | master-detail (parent) | master-detail (task line) | saved-view-filter | screen-flow |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 25 s | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 2 | 0 | 22 s | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 3 | 0 | 21 s | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 4 | 0 | 21 s | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 5 | 0 | 21 s | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

Before, at the 18.1.0 pin on `76e90df6` (os-dev-report 6461924763): 0/5 runs green; action-modal, both master-detail cases and screen-flow failed identically on every run, and only saved-view-filter passed.

Wall times are shared-box seconds. One backend process served all five runs.

## Acceptance notes

- The lane stays runnable by hand only; no workflow runs it. The required wiring, and the retirement of this published-package pin, belong to step 2.
- `skip-changeset`: the file is under `ui/e2e/`, which no package publishes.
